verdict.rationale: The evidence documents role-based access control, where privileges are assigned to roles and roles to users, and an SQL API that can provision users and roles. It never documents issuing API credentials (tokens, keys, OAuth clients) scoped to an agent. RBAC and user provisioning are adjacent access-control building blocks, not documented least-privilege credential issuance for agents, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
